essence: The pot installation should begin by first wrapping the pot with a red cloth.
The thread-covered items together with cloth and other things should be placed near the head.
The threaded and water-filled items should also be presided over by Vajradeha and the other powers.
After invoking with the form born from the heart cavity, the presence is made complete.
After placing the Śarabheśa mantra, one should worship in Viṣṇu as previously instructed.
